drafts.subject: Updated Q3 pricing ahead of your board meeting
drafts.body:
Hello,

Ahead of your board meeting at the end of the month, here is the updated Q3 pricing sheet for your renewal. After our internal review we are holding at your current tier; the sheet reflects that pricing with no additional discount applied.

Happy to walk through the reasoning on a short call if that would help.

Best regards
